en-US.description: Cue-based media playback and show control for live video
en-US.longDescription:
Deckboy is a native desktop application for video engineers, AV technicians and live
operators who need a reliable way to organise media, trigger cues, loop content and send
video to production displays.

Cues are arranged in a playlist with fades, loops and hold-last-frame behaviour, and sent
to dedicated fullscreen outputs with per-output area of interest, edge feathering and
warp or keystone correction. Output can leave the machine as NDI, SRT, RTMP, Blackmagic
SDI or SMPTE ST 2110, several at once. Playback is driven from a Stream Deck, Bitfocus
Companion, OSC, MIDI, Art-Net or LTC timecode.

It also converts media that will not play, reports codec, raster, frame rate and duration
for any file, normalises loudness to EBU R128, generates test patterns, and captures a
camera, window or screen as a cue. PDF, PowerPoint and Keynote decks import as one cue per
slide, with presenter and prompter views available as output types.
